en: A black‑and‑white postcard view of a rural settlement surrounded by forested hills. In the mid‑ground are several wooden buildings, including a larger two‑storey house and smaller farm or guesthouse structures, beside a calm pond or small river. A wooden fence runs along the foreground with rocks and a dirt road, and there are a few small figures near the water. At the top left, printed text reads "Fagernæs, Ringsaker".
